HL.Title: HoloSuite Loot
HL.BuildMismatch: The GM has not loaded the same HoloLoot build. Restart Foundry and reload both GM and player clients.
HL.RefreshInventory: Refresh loot from this NPC's inventory
HL.InventoryRefreshed: Loot refreshed from this NPC's inventory.
HL.RefreshUnsupported: Inventory refresh is only available for loot that comes from the NPC's inventory.
HL.RefreshUntracked: Loot cannot be refreshed because this corpse has a transfer whose source inventory cannot be verified.
HL.DropItems: Drag Items here from the sidebar or a compendium. Their quantities and item data are preserved.
HL.TokenOnly: Applies to this placed token only. Other tokens and the NPC's inventory are unchanged.
HL.SnapshotLocked: This token already has a loot snapshot. Its source is locked to prevent regenerating collected loot. You can still change lootability.
HL.NoActor: Assign a character in User Configuration, or ask the GM for ownership of a character Actor.
HL.ActorDenied: Choose a character you own. Loot cannot be transferred to that Actor.
HL.Unavailable: This token is no longer available for looting.
HL.AccessDenied: Loot requires a visible, non-hidden token on your current scene and an owned observer with line of sight. Ask the GM to view that scene if visibility cannot be validated.
HL.OutOfRange: Move your character's token closer to loot this target.
HL.NoGM: An active HoloLoot GM is required. Ask a GM to connect and view this scene.
HL.Unsupported: HoloLoot supports D&D5e and Starfinder Second Edition. No adapter is registered for this system.
HL.TransferFailed: The transfer could not be confirmed. Refresh and retry with the same character. Reserved loot remains protected.
HL.RecoveryRequired: This loot has a pending transfer or missing snapshot. Ask the GM to inspect the destination inventory and HoloLoot state before releasing it.
HL.PersistenceFailed: Loot state could not be saved. No new transfer was started.
HL.Timeout: The GM did not reply in time. Refresh before retrying; a transfer may already have completed.
HL.InvalidItem: Drop a physical inventory Item supported by the current system. Natural weapons and non-inventory mechanics cannot be loot.
HL.SelectToken: Right-click a lootable NPC, or select or target one token and open HoloSuite Loot.
HL.CoreMissing: HoloSuite Core is required. HoloLoot has not started.
HL.ZeroHPHint: Enable Automatic lootability for defeated, dead, or zero-HP NPCs. Always lootable and Disabled still override detection.
HL.LootRangeHint: Maximum distance from a character token to the loot. Defaults to 15 ft. Set to 0 to disable the distance limit.
HL.ChatLogHint: Post collected loot to public chat, showing the receiving character, source, item or currency, and quantity. Off by default.
HL.CharacterSelectorHint: Allow players to choose an owned character. Off by default: use their assigned character, their single owned character token on the scene, or their single owned character.
HL.RuleHint: Choose a scope, select items, then apply a loot behavior. A dice formula rolls on pickup to determine how many items the player receives. Fixed quantities and currency are capped by available stock. Actor and global rules apply to future loot snapshots.
HL.QuantityRollChat: Loot quantity for {item}: {quantity} lootable after the inventory limit.
HL.RuleLocked: This corpse's snapshot is locked. Choose another scope to set rules for future loot.
HL.RuleMissingSnapshot: No matching stack in this corpse's snapshot. Choose another scope to set rules for future loot.
HL.RuleNoActorItem: This item is only on the placed token.
HL.RuleNoSharedSource: This item has no shared source.
HL.SelectRuleItems: Select all available for this scope
HL.InvalidRule: Enter a whole quantity or a dice formula such as 1d6 or 2d4+1.
HL.RuleGM: Edit rules from the active HoloLoot GM session.
HL.RuleScopeUnavailable: One or more selected items can no longer be edited at this scope. Reopen the configuration and try again.
HL.AmbiguousActor: More than one owned character is available. Assign your character in User Configuration, or ask the GM to enable the character selector.
HL.SourceChanged: The NPC inventory changed during this transfer. Retry to reconcile it, or ask the GM to inspect the reserved item. Already received items will not be granted twice.
HL.CurrencyChanged: The currency balance changed or could not be confirmed. Retry with the same character; reserved transfers will not pay twice.
HL.HideGmLootButton: Hide GM Loot button on tokens
HL.HideGmLootButtonHint: Hide the Loot button from the GM token HUD. Loot configuration is still available from Core and Token Configuration.
HL.PanelThemeHint: Choose the look of the loot popup for everyone in this world.
